name: What's the difference between a plumbing repair and a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a plumbing repair and a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A plumbing repair addresses a specific fault, like a leaking pipe or a faulty fixture, to restore function. A full replacement involves installing new pipes or components, often due to extensive damage, age, or to upgrade to more efficient systems. We assess the damage to determine the most cost-effective and durable solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes a specific fault, while replacement involves installing new components due to extensive damage or age.
